name: vscode-tql
description: Syntax highlighting for the Tenzir Query Language (TQL)

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:tql && npm run build:wasm:yaml
scripts.build:wasm:tql: mkdir -p parsers queries/tql && cd ../tree-sitter-tql && tree-sitter build --wasm && cp tree-sitter-tql.wasm ../vscode-tql/parsers/tree-sitter-tql.wasm && cp queries/tql/highlights.scm ../vscode-tql/queries/tql/highlights.scm && cp queries/tql/injections.scm ../vscode-tql/queries/tql/injections.scm
scripts.build:wasm:yaml: mkdir -p parsers queries/yaml && cp node_modules/@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml/tree-sitter-yaml.wasm parsers/tree-sitter-yaml.wasm && cp node_modules/@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml/queries/highlights.scm queries/yaml/highlights.scm
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prebuild && npm run compile
